01 / 04

A practical example

At the AIS graduation ceremony in May 2025, I helped with event coordination, guest seating, logistics, setup, attendee guidance, and backstage operations.

The role is recorded as Student Volunteer on my LinkedIn profile. Those duties involved supporting staff and students as part of a wider programme.

The connection

The usefulness of communication in that setting is concrete.

Read the deeper context+

An attendee needs the right guidance, a task needs to be understood, and staff need support that fits the flow of the event. I do not enlarge that role into overall event leadership, but it gives a practical example of contribution.

02 / 04

Writing as evidence

My LinkedIn posts describe experiences at aviation, cybersecurity, technology, finance, real estate, and governance events.

They offer a reader the opportunity to inspect how I select an observation and explain why it mattered to me.

The connection

Writing is also a skill I want to improve.

Read the deeper context+

A strong reflection should distinguish what I saw from what I inferred, use an appropriate source where one is needed, and make a point without relying on excitement alone. The journal preserves source links so that readers can compare the expanded narrative with its original context.

03 / 04

Language and listening

My profile lists eight languages at different levels.

Urdu and Punjabi are native or bilingual; Hindi is full professional; English is professional working; Arabic is limited working; French, German, and Korean are elementary. Those differences are relevant to communication and should remain visible.

The connection

After the UNESCO forum I wrote about the value of conversations with people from different countries and backgrounds.

Read the deeper context+

Listening to different perspectives can reveal how much context sits behind a position. I want to develop that attention alongside my ability to express my own ideas.

04 / 04

A continuing development priority

Clear communication is one of the foundations I want to carry into future legal study.

That means developing accuracy, structure, and an awareness of the reader, rather than simply sounding formal. My current evidence is student-level volunteering and writing.

The connection

The next step is more practice in real tasks: explaining a difficult idea, writing a sourced summary, asking a focused question, and checking that another person has understood.

Read the deeper context+

Those examples would offer stronger evidence than an unsupported claim of advanced communication skills.

Source context

Profile facts were reviewed on 6 October 2026. Expanded prose provides personal and learning context; listed achievements remain separate from future ambitions.
